title: Audit one-sided padding: exact field scope and normalization costs
body:
Adds one isolated audit package. **No new κ.**

1,022 exact integer minors cover all 511 binary characters: P112 has 503 rank-eight and eight rank-seven complements; P120 has 511 rank-eight complements. Power-of-two determinants extend the local padding lemma to every scalar field of characteristic other than two, with the binary cost table fixed. Padding costs normalized cost + 8, at most raw cost + 8. A new rational cancellation fixture gives 72 → 64 → 72; skipping the merge costs 81.

New: literal PR2816 chart binding, explicit P120/field extension, and the correction-loss fixture. The real support census belongs to PR845/1098/1815; padding to PR3074/2816; merging to PR1224. This confirms the parent's normalized accounting, not a counterexample to its conditional implication.

Remote complete tree equals the tested tree.

Reproduce (Python 3.12, standard library):
```sh
python3 -B research/one-sided-padding-audit/verify.py
```
Expected: PASS_ONE_SIDED_PADDING_AUDIT; no_new_kappa.

Passed: normal, optimized, registered and Git-free replay; byte-identical certificate regeneration; 256 lift masks; all 6,560 nonzero F3 directions; 11 semantic negative controls and source-tamper rejection. The pinned parent checker passes its 12 fixtures plus the cancellation fixture.

Written proof plus exact finite certificates, not formal-kernel verification. L120 remains open. No global decoder floor, new supplier or multiplication improvement; physical, recursive and analytic obligations are untouched. No selected cold replay or hosted CI claimed.

Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds, Mihir Srivastava, Adam Gall, Jose Manuel, joaqcoo, Philippe Van Velzen and the retained geometry/supplier contributors. Apache-2.0.
